boundaries: All source arrays were previously inspected development data.
Objective gaps and uncertainty balls are ordinary FP64 diagnostics, not certificates.
Sensitivity varies training labels with retained training/validation designs and penalty fixed; it does not enclose feature/design error, distribution shift or deployment precision error.
Projection is never selected; action-energy is uniform shrinkage, not a derived physical prior.
Validation selections use the fixed candidate menu; reported diagnostic comparisons do not make another choice.
No new inference timing or matched-accuracy speedup was measured.
The residual on the sampled 40-feature design is not a lower bound on full-operator or new-architecture error.

proposed_next_gate.controls: Frozen global 40-feature readout, zero/ordered2, and saved classical controls on identical queries. Declare SVD rank cutoff, conditioning, sensitivity and all denominators before fitting.
proposed_next_gate.design: On the retained 32x8 training cell, freeze 192 context-local five-coefficient source-linear diagnostic fits using each context's eight calibration actions; score the four source-heldout actions per context (768 queries).
proposed_next_gate.evaluation_only_oracle: A second, explicitly evaluation-only five-coefficient projection may jointly fit the four withheld source actions per training context. It is never selected, deployed or described as out-of-sample. A fixed truncated-SVD projection gives a residual floor only within that retained numerical span on those sampled actions, not for the full operator or discarded directions.
proposed_next_gate.interpretation: Stable large oracle gains implicate coefficient-map/identification; small gains with large residual implicate branch span; unstable source-heldout gains implicate source coverage. Any derived BCH/Magnus branch, encoder, new labels or confirmation remains separately frozen future work.
proposed_next_gate.limits: Context-local fits consume context labels and are diagnostic oracles, not deployed models or new-parent generalization. Do not fit validation/diagnostic withheld truth; those parents lack calibration actions. Training orthogonality does not remove heldout signed cross terms.
proposed_next_gate.novelty: This attribution audit is established diagnostic methodology, not itself novelty. Novelty would require a distinct mathematically justified response mechanism and independent competitive evidence.
proposed_next_gate.question: Is remaining error caused mainly by the five-branch source-action span or its shared eight-feature state-to-coefficient map?

review_scope: Independent evaluation of all retained candidates, spectra, selection and sensitivity; no fits, teacher solves or uploaded-code execution
